weak_videos.title: Romans' Concrete HEALS ITSELF 🤯 #Shorts
likely_reasons: Western-centric history often underperforms compared to Indian-centric history on this channel.
The hook is a statement rather than a question or a challenge to the viewer.

what_works: India-centric rankings (Highest earning cities, Powerful countries) are the top performers.
Hindi titles or Hinglish titles (Hindi text + English keywords) significantly outperform pure English titles.
Videos between 45-52 seconds seem to be the 'sweet spot' for the algorithm on this channel.
Using 'Shock' emojis (😱, 😲) and custom thumbnails correlates with views above 1,500.

diagnosis.hook: Weak videos use 'Statement Hooks' (e.g., 'Photosynthesis Explained') instead of 'Curiosity Hooks' (e.g., 'भारत किस नंबर पर है?'). The best videos ask a question or promise a ranking.
diagnosis.buildup: The data shows that 'Top 5' or list-based structures (Cities, Countries, Missiles) keep viewers engaged longer than single-topic deep dives like the TATA video.
diagnosis.visuals: There is a clear drop in performance for videos without custom thumbnails. Recent history videos (Chola, British Raj) are currently underperforming, likely due to the lack of a visual 'click-bait' element.
diagnosis.titles_topics: Geopolitics and National Pride (India vs China, India's power) are the strongest topics. Science and Biology (Shrimp, Photosynthesis) are the weakest.
diagnosis.other: Videos published between 7:00 AM and 9:00 AM IST show more consistent growth than those published in the late afternoon.

hook_rules: Must start with a question in Hindi (e.g., 'क्या आपको पता है...?').
Mention 'India' or 'Bharat' in the first 3 seconds.
Use a 'Negative Hook' occasionally (e.g., 'Google पर ये कभी सर्च मत करना').
The first frame must have text that contradicts common knowledge.
Always use at least one 'Shock' or 'Fire' emoji in the first 20 characters.
buildup_rules: Use the 'Countdown' method (5, 4, 3, 2, 1) to force retention.
Every 10 seconds, introduce a new 'fact layer' to prevent swiping.
Use a 'Bridge' sentence halfway through (e.g., 'लेकिन असली ट्विस्ट तो अब आएगा').
Keep the background music's BPM high to maintain energy.
visual_rules: Custom thumbnails are mandatory; use high-contrast faces or flags.
Text overlays must be large, bold, and yellow/white for readability.
Change the visual on screen every 2-3 seconds minimum.
Use split-screen visuals if the topic is a comparison (India vs China).
title_rules: Mix Hindi script with English keywords (Hinglish).
Keep titles under 60 characters to avoid truncation.
Never use 'Description:' or technical tags in the visible title area.
topic_rules: Focus on 'India vs The World' geopolitics.
Focus on 'Wealth and Money' (Richest cities, Business secrets).
avoid: Avoid Western-only history without an Indian connection.
Avoid publishing without a custom thumbnail.
Avoid titles that explain the whole story (No spoilers).
